title: 第03章 您已被群主荒天帝禁言三百年第04章 新成员叶黑奔驰大帝加入群聊
slug: 遮天刚成天帝聊天群什么鬼
content_zh:
【群聊‘相亲相爱一家人’邀您进群！】
【请问是否同意？】
林昭脚踏万道而立，他浑身散发出恐怖的极道皇威，恐怖的威压浩浩荡荡的席卷了整个大宇宙，混沌钟的钟鸣声响彻天上地下……
现如今。
他的战力已经飙升到了天帝级。
何为天帝？
这里的天帝并非一个称呼！
而是一个战力的体现。
通常情况下。
普通大帝需要逆活三世才能够达到天帝级战力，但林昭如今一世便达到了，由此足以看出他的强大……
一世比肩他人三世。
从古至今。
也只有寥寥几人能够做到。
神话时代的帝尊、太古末年的斗战圣皇（疑似）、荒古时代的狠人大帝、无始大帝、青帝、叶天帝……
毫不夸张的说。
天帝级战力就是成仙的一个小门槛。
为什么这么说呢？
因为只有达到了天帝级的战力才能够打进奇异世界，就是那个夹在九天十地与仙域的特殊小世界！
“我都证道天帝了！”
“聊天群才来？”

林昭有些哭笑不得。
相亲相爱一家人？
这个群名称有点意思哈！
“同意！”
林昭心念一动。
下一刻。
他的面前骤然出现了一块虚无面板。
【群聊功能——】
【公告聊天区域、群友私聊、红包发送……】
【其他功能尚在开辟中……】
【当前群聊成员：2】
“当前群聊成员只有两个？”
林昭有些惊讶。
他下意识的看向了群聊成员列表，想要看看另外一个成员是谁。
然后…
林昭突然沉默了。
content_en:
[Group chat ‘Love each other as a family’ invites you to join the group! 】
[Do you agree? 】
Lin Zhao stood with his feet on the ten thousand paths. He exuded the terrifying power of the Supreme Emperor. The terrifying pressure swept across the entire universe, and the chimes of the Chaos Clock resounded throughout the sky and the earth...
Today.
His combat power has soared to the level of the Emperor of Heaven.
What is the Emperor of Heaven?
The Emperor of Heaven here is not a title!
Rather, it is a manifestation of combat power.
Usually.
Ordinary emperors need to survive three lives to reach the level of Heavenly Emperor, but Lin Zhao has achieved it in one life now, which shows how powerful he is...
One life is comparable to others in three lives.
From ancient times to the present.
Only a few people can do it.
The Emperor of the Mythical Age, the Dou Zhan Holy Emperor (suspected) at the end of the ancient times, the ruthless Emperor of the ancient times, the Wushi Emperor, the Qing Emperor, the Ye Tian Emperor...
Quite literally.
Heavenly Emperor level combat power is a small threshold for becoming an immortal.
Why do you say that?
Because only those who have reached the Heavenly Emperor level of combat power can enter the strange world, that special small world sandwiched between the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths and the Immortal Realm!
"I have already attained enlightenment as the Emperor of Heaven!"
"Just come to the chat group?"
Lin Zhao didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
A loving family?
This group name is a bit interesting!
"Agree!"
Lin Zhao thought.
The next moment.
A void panel suddenly appeared in front of him.
[Group chat function——]
[Announcement chat area, group friends private chat, red envelope sending...]
[Other functions are still under development...]
[Current group chat members: 2]
"There are only two members in the group chat currently?"
Lin Zhao was a little surprised.
He subconsciously looked at the group chat member list to see who the other member was.
Then…
Lin Zhao suddenly fell silent.
